text: Henichesk. We are beginning the push to free the south. Strategic aircraft have entered the fight.
The big ones, carrying the new missiles?
Exactly. Those missiles are much faster and more dangerous. Intercept them with fire or move out of their path early.
Our aircraft are making a planned turn. If the footage shows them flying away from the dragon, that is part of the plan.
A decent plan. They should stay on that heading, away from our cities.
